text:
A circuit contains a fixed resistor. The potential difference across the resistor is 24.0V and the
current in the resistor is 2.30A.
How much energy is transferred in the resistor in a time of 17.0minutes?
A
938J
B
5630J
C
56.3kJ
D
9.38kJ
subject: Physics
